contentText:
Peso Pluma shares his pride for the Mexican national team, his predictions for the second match against South Korea and his gratitude for “Daño” being on Billboard ’s Hot Latin Songs chart before taking the stage at BMO Stadium.

Peso Pluma: And because we Mexicans are the most badass, man, call them! Well, I hope they give it their all, that my buddy Julián keeps crushing it, may God bless them and may they give it their all so that this time we’re in that sixth game. And we’re going to be supporting from outside, as it should be. Well, really happy. A lot of joy for the guys, for the whole country. We’re celebrating the first World Cup game because we won it, we won the first three points. I hope it continues and, well, really happy because we debuted on the right foot. Well, Mexico’s going to win. Mexico has to win. Attract it. The law of attraction. Mexico’s going to win. How much is Mexico going to win by, guys? By how much?

Guest 1: They’re going to win 3-0.

Peso Pluma: Just like that, South Korea, watch out. How do I see the game? Yeah, honestly I did celebrate with the crew. No, we screamed a lot. We screamed, we screamed. It makes us euphoric because we’re Mexican and we’re the most badass, that’s why. Well, it’s really awesome that all us Mexicans are so united in this country, that we come to work and to give the best of ourselves. And we’re really happy that all us Mexicans put on the jersey the day the Mexican National Team plays and that we support each other, as it should be. Honestly, whatever Willy sends me, I wear it, because Willy knows it. Willy already knows what show, what vibe.

Keep watching for more!
